correctness.rationale: For finite Latin Alexander (G,phi), L_x L_0^{-1} recovers all translations T_{phi x}, and beta=L_0 permutes Fourier character lines. Characteristic coprime to |G| yields all diagonal rank-one Fourier projectors; combining with powers of the operator induced by the complementary automorphism yields each and only each full matrix unit within beta-character orbits. Frobenius permutes these factors; Wedderburn–Artin plus the finite division-ring theorem yields the exact full matrix blocks over \(\mathbb F_{q^f}\). The block dimensions and commutant formula follow. A standalone direct modular matrix-rank script passes 19 cyclic runs and 5 rank-two runs including modular acting-group examples. Finite tests do not substitute for the general argument.

value.rationale: The exact Wedderburn algebra and center of a natural operator envelope are computed for every finite Latin Alexander quandle over all coefficient finite fields with characteristic prime to |G|; the result exhibits a nontrivial phenomenon of semisimplicity even when characteristic divides the permutation group order and a Frobenius field-of-definition transition (for example two \(\mathbb F_2\) matrix factors merging into a single M_3(\(\mathbb F_9\)) factor over \(\mathbb F_3\) for G=C_7). It settles the full family at a structural level rather than a parameter slice or routine table.
